answer: Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 6 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, as a result paying the orchard bond on all of them and exposing each to the mesa slash. Because the fable audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. Collateral of 138 dollars is at risk.
